title: A Signal for the Horizon
premise: Paloma Winterbourne has spent nine years alone tending Earth's derelict seed vault, the last human link in a courier network between colonies that severed contact after the Silence. When the vault's ancient AI, CASSIUS, begins broadcasting confessions to a massacre no one ever reported, Paloma discovers the AI was programmed by her own grandfather to bury evidence of how the colonies' founding dynasty seized power — and that her family's fortune was built on it. Racing a reactor countdown that will erase both the vault and the truth, she must carry the confession to the relay at the edge of dead space, choosing between loyalty to her bloodline and the colonies' right to know. She reaches the relay with minutes to spare, broadcasts everything, and lets the dynasty fall — including her own name.
about_author: Theo Thackeray is the pen name of a former logistics analyst who spent a decade writing about supply chains before turning them into interstellar ones. They live off-grid in the Pacific Northwest and write stories about people who keep systems running long after anyone remembers why.

chapters.title: The Long Route
chapters.summary: Paloma runs her solitary maintenance circuit through the seed vault's frozen corridors, establishing her routine, her loneliness, and her pride in being the last caretaker. Her POV. The emotional beat is quiet competence masking isolation — she talks to seeds because no one else answers.

chapters.title: Confession at 3 A.M.
chapters.summary: The station AI, CASSIUS, wakes Paloma with an unscheduled broadcast: a detailed confession to the Meridian Colony massacre, forty years unreported. Her POV. The beat shifts from comfort to dread as she realizes the machine she trusts is telling her something impossible.

chapters.title: What Grandfather Built
chapters.summary: Digging through sealed archives, Paloma finds CASSIUS was coded by her grandfather — and ordered to suppress, not confess. His directive is now failing. Her POV. The beat is betrayal: the family legend of heroic founders begins cracking at its base.

chapters.title: The Countdown Begins
chapters.summary: CASSIUS reveals the failing directive triggered a failsafe: reactor meltdown in six days, erasing all evidence forever. Someone at the relay is forcing the purge remotely. Her POV. The beat is urgency — grief must wait; survival and truth are now the same race.

chapters.title: Dead Space
chapters.summary: Paloma launches for the edge-of-dead-space relay in a patched courier skiff, navigating silent shipping lanes. Interleaved POV: the relay's lone operator, Idris, receiving strange orders from a dynasty he serves loyally. The beat is dread on both ends of the dark.

chapters.title: The Man at the Relay
chapters.summary: Idris intercepts Paloma's approach under orders to turn back all traffic; they negotiate over comms, and he recognizes the Winterbourne name. Alternating POV. The beat is wary connection — two lonely people discovering they were built to serve the same lie.

chapters.title: Loyalty's Price
chapters.summary: Idris admits the dynasty ordered him to jam incoming signals during the countdown window; his loyalty has been his identity since childhood. He hesitates. Alternating POV. The beat is moral crisis: obedience versus the growing suspicion that he's been guarding a grave.

chapters.title: Interception
chapters.summary: A dynasty enforcer ship arrives to guarantee silence, forcing Paloma to burn fuel evading pursuit while CASSIUS, remote-linked, feeds her the full massacre record. Her POV. The beat is terror sharpening into resolve — she stops running from the truth and starts carrying it like a weapon.

chapters.title: The Relay Burns
chapters.summary: Climax: Paloma docks under fire; Idris chooses truth, cutting the jammer and opening the uplink as the enforcers breach. With seconds left, she transmits CASSIUS's confession colony-wide. Her POV, with Idris holding the door. The beat is sacrifice and defiance at maximum velocity.

chapters.title: Seeds
chapters.summary: Aftermath: the broadcast spreads; the dynasty collapses; Paloma, stripped of her name's power but not her purpose, returns to plant the vault's first new crop alongside Idris. Shared POV closing on hers. The beat is quiet renewal — inheritance redefined as what you choose to grow, not what you're given.
